Die Dokumentation dieser Integration wird von ihrem Autor geschrieben und ist bisher nur auf Englisch verfügbar.

Follow your sports teams in Gladys: live scores, the next match, and scenes that run
when your team scores or wins.

> **Beta.** Scores come from ESPN's public API, which is free but undocumented: it can
> change without notice. Feedback is welcome on the
> [GitHub repository](https://github.com/prohand/gladys-teamtracker/issues) or on the
> [Gladys forum](https://community.gladysassistant.com/).

## What you get

- **One device per team**, with three values:
  - **Score**: your team's score in the current (or last) match;
  - **Opponent score**;
  - **Match**: one line, e.g. `Live · 63' · PSG 2 – 1 OM`,
    `Final · PSG 2 – 1 OM · Win` or `Next · Sat, Oct 17, 05:15 PM · at STR`.
- **Scene triggers**: match starting soon, match started, my team scored, opponent
  scored, match ended.
- **A scene action** that reads the match of a team, to announce the score or to change
  the lights depending on the result.
- **Two dashboard widgets**: the live match of one team, and the list of all your teams.

No account, no API key, nothing to install on your network. Gladys 5.1 or later is
required.

## Configuration

1. Open the **Configuration** tab of the integration.
2. In **Teams**, write the teams to follow as `LEAGUE:TEAM`, separated by commas:

   ```
   LIG1:PSG, TOP14:RAC, NFL:KC, NBA:LAL
   ```

   - `LEAGUE` is a code of the [table below](#leagues).
   - `TEAM` is the team's abbreviation (`PSG`, `KC`) or its ESPN id (`160`).
   - Not sure? Click **Find a team**, pick the league, type part of the name: the
     integration lists the exact lines to paste.

3. Pick the **language** of the match texts and your **time zone** (e.g.
   `America/New_York`, `Europe/Paris`), used to write kickoff times.
4. Save, then click **Test the teams**: every team is listed with its current or next
   match, and every entry that cannot be followed says why.
5. Open the **Discovery** tab and add the team devices.

### Other settings

| Setting                       | Default      | Meaning                                                   |
| ----------------------------- | ------------ | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| Kickoff reminder (min)        | 30           | The "Match starting soon" trigger fires this long before. |
| Refresh during a match (s)    | 30           | How often scores are read while a match is live.          |
| Refresh between matches (min) | 15           | How often the next matches are checked otherwise.         |
| Time zone                     | Europe/Paris | Kickoff times are written in this zone (IANA name).       |
| Language of the match texts   | English      | Language of the "Match" line and of the scene `summary`.  |

The integration wakes up on its own for the reminder and for the kickoff: you do not
need a short refresh to catch the start of a match.

## Leagues

| Code   | League                 | Code    | League                  |
| ------ | ---------------------- | ------- | ----------------------- |
| `LIG1` | Ligue 1                | `TOP14` | Top 14                  |
| `LIG2` | Ligue 2                | `SIXN`  | Six Nations             |
| `CDF`  | Coupe de France        | `RWC`   | Rugby World Cup         |
| `D1F`  | Première Ligue (women) | `NFL`   | NFL                     |
| `EPL`  | Premier League         | `NCAAF` | NCAA Football           |
| `LIGA` | LaLiga                 | `NBA`   | NBA                     |
| `SERA` | Serie A                | `WNBA`  | WNBA                    |
| `BUND` | Bundesliga             | `NCAAM` | NCAA Men's Basketball   |
| `CL`   | Champions League       | `NCAAW` | NCAA Women's Basketball |
| `EL`   | Europa League          | `NHL`   | NHL                     |
| `ECL`  | Conference League      | `MLB`   | MLB                     |
| `MLS`  | MLS                    | `WC`    | FIFA World Cup          |
| `NWSL` | NWSL                   | `WWC`   | FIFA Women's World Cup  |

**Another league?** Any ESPN team league works with its two path segments instead of a
code: `soccer/por.1:SLB` (Liga Portugal), `soccer/ned.1:AJA` (Eredivisie). They are the
two parts after `/sports/` in the ESPN API addresses.

**A team in two competitions** (Ligue 1 and Champions League) is two entries:
`LIG1:PSG, CL:PSG`. Each is its own device.

**Same abbreviation for two teams** (three Top 14 teams are `STA`): use the ESPN id that
**Find a team** gives (`TOP14:25922` for Stade Toulousain).

Individual sports (tennis, golf, F1, MMA) are not supported: a match there is not two
teams with a score.

## Scenes

The integration adds its own cards to the scene editor, under the **Integrations**
category.

### Triggers

| Trigger             | When                                                  |
| ------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| Match starting soon | The kickoff reminder is due (30 min before, default). |
| Match started       | The match went live.                                  |
| My team scored      | Your team's score went up (goal, try, touchdown…).    |
| Opponent scored     | The opponent's score went up.                         |
| Match ended         | The match is over; filter on win, loss or draw.       |

Every trigger can be limited to one **team** and to **home** or **away** matches; left
empty, any team matches. The following actions can read the details with
`{{triggerEvent.data.<name>}}`:

| Variable         | Example                      | Triggers                        |
| ---------------- | ---------------------------- | ------------------------------- |
| `team_name`      | `Paris Saint-Germain`        | all                             |
| `opponent`       | `Strasbourg`                 | all                             |
| `home_away`      | `away`                       | all                             |
| `league`         | `Ligue 1`                    | all                             |
| `team_score`     | `2`                          | all                             |
| `opponent_score` | `1`                          | all                             |
| `summary`        | `Live · 63' · PSG 2 – 1 STR` | all                             |
| `points`         | `1` (`6` for a touchdown)    | my team scored, opponent scored |
| `result`         | `win`, `loss` or `draw`      | match ended                     |
| `kickoff`        | `2026-10-17T15:15Z`          | match starting soon             |
| `minutes`        | `30`                         | match starting soon             |

Examples:

- **Goal light**: "My team scored" → turn the living room lights green for 30 seconds.
- **Match reminder**: "Match starting soon" → send a message "\{\{triggerEvent.data.summary\}\}".
- **Result**: "Match ended", result = win → play a song.

Scores are read every 30 seconds by default: an event arrives up to that long after the
action on the field, plus ESPN's own delay.

### Action: Get the match of a team

Gives the following actions the current or next match of a team: `state` (`pre`, `in`,
`post` or `none`), `is_live`, `team_score`, `opponent_score`, `opponent`, `kickoff`,
`result` and `summary`. It answers from the last reading, without calling ESPN.

The two scores are also device values: a scene **condition** can compare them ("only if
my team leads").

## Dashboard

- **Team match**: pick a team in the widget settings. Live score (it follows the device
  values in real time once the device is created), clock, kickoff, opponent, home or
  away, and a **Refresh** button.
- **My teams**: every followed team with its logo, live matches first, with a **LIVE**,
  result or **NEXT** badge.

## Troubleshooting

- **A team is missing from Discovery**: click **Test the teams**, it says why (unknown
  league, team not found, abbreviation shared by several teams, ESPN unreachable).
- **The badge of a team is "unreachable"**: ESPN did not answer the last reading. The
  last known scores stay displayed; the next reading tries again.
- **Kickoff times are off by some hours**: set your **Time zone**.
- **Logs**: open the integration logs in Gladys. Each scene event is logged
  (`Scene event team_scored <- LIG1:PSG: …`).

## Privacy

The integration only sends ESPN the leagues and team ids it reads. It needs no account
and stores one small file in its own `/data` volume (the last reading of each team).

Not sure of the abbreviation? Use the "Find a team" button below. Each team becomes a device in the Discovery tab. |

| Kickoff reminder (min) | `number` | Nein | The "Match starting soon" trigger fires this many minutes before kickoff. 0 turns it off. |
| Refresh during a match (s) | `number` | Nein | How often scores are read while a match is live, in seconds. |
| Refresh between matches (min) | `number` | Nein | How often the next matches are checked when nothing is live, in minutes. |

## So installierst du Team Tracker in Gladys

1. Öffne in Gladys **Integrationen**: Team Tracker erscheint im Katalog neben den nativen Integrationen, mit einem Community-Badge.
2. Klicke auf **Installieren**. Gladys lädt das Docker-Image (`ghcr.io/prohand/gladys-teamtracker:1.0.1`) herunter, startet es in einer vom Kern isolierten Sandbox und erzeugt die Oberfläche der Integration (Geräte, Erkennung und Konfiguration).
3. Öffne den Bildschirm **Konfiguration** der Integration, fülle die Einstellungen aus und speichere.
4. Du kannst sie auch direkt über die URL ihres Repositorys installieren: [https://github.com/prohand/gladys-teamtracker](https://github.com/prohand/gladys-teamtracker).

Team Tracker benötigt Gladys `>=5.1.0`. Der Katalog in Gladys wird stündlich aktualisiert, eine neue Version ist also spätestens eine Stunde nach ihrer Veröffentlichung verfügbar.

Du nutzt Gladys noch nicht? Es ist kostenlos und Open Source: [folge der Installationsanleitung](/de/docs/), um loszulegen.

## Über externe Integrationen

Team Tracker ist eine **externe Integration**: eine Community-Integration, die als Docker-Container verpackt und auf GitHub veröffentlicht wird. Gladys installiert sie mit einem Klick und führt sie in einer vom Kern isolierten Sandbox aus. Sie wird von [prohand](https://github.com/prohand) veröffentlicht und gepflegt, nicht vom Gladys-Kernteam.
